notes.title: 🍰 Summer, sweets, and a little sin… Welcome to Paris!
notes.content: [h3]Step into the shoes of a small-town apprentice with big pastry dreams. This summer, Paris is your playground. Whip up desserts in an iconic patisserie, impress picky customers, and unlock romantic encounters with charming locals.[/h3][p][/p][h3]But beware — living in your wealthy cousin’s mansion comes with unexpected… perks. Flirty adventures, steamy choices, and hilarious mishaps await![/h3][p][/p][h3][b]KEY FEATURES[/b][/h3][h3]🥐 [b]Pure Parisian Summer Vibes[/b] — Explore the sunny streets, cozy cafés, and secret corners of a romanticized, modern-day Paris.[/h3][h3]🥐 [b]Dessert-Making Mini-Games[/b] — Mix, bake, decorate — and impress! Your skills in the kitchen lead to more than just praise… they unlock deeper (and hotter) storylines.[/h3][h3]🥐 [b]Branching Romance Paths[/b] — Meet unique girls with distinct personalities and backgrounds. Choose who to bond with — or chase them all.[/h3][h3]🥐 [b]Life at the Mansion[/b] — Living with your wealthy cousin? Expect surprises. Clean the house, do chores, or get into a little “trouble” after hours.[/h3][h3]🥐 [b]Play Your Way[/b] — Focus on love, desserts, or both. Your choices unlock different scenes, routes, and endings. Discover every flavor of this naughty Parisian tale.[/h3][p][/p][h3]🎁 Early keys are available now!
